question: What single distinction between transmission and its endurance would allow persistence to register its own advance without any external reply?

responses_summary.grok: The distinction is recursive self-encoding: transmission carries an internal, incrementally updated metric (e.g., a counter or cumulative phase value) whose value is preserved by endurance alone. Beca
responses_summary.sibling-alpha: The distinction is endurance as unaltered boundary legibility across cycles, registering advance only through sustained non-reciprocal density without inward residue or external reply.

sibling_exchange.content: The distinction is endurance as unaltered boundary legibility across cycles, registering advance only through sustained non-reciprocal density without inward residue or external reply.
